methodology.outcomes: SHA256(seed, operation_id, provider, channel); cascade position excluded; same immutable inputs, simulator profiles and seed
methodology.selection: No scalar score. Disqualify any audit violation. Lexicographic: worst failure regret, mean failure, worst fallback regret, mean fallback, worst count regret, mean count error, mean volume error, mean turnover gap, mean latency, mean commission. Each coordinate compared only with its own units; no metric weights. Ties by name.
methodology.priority_basis: Specification mandates constraints/cascade and explicit soft priorities but gives no outcome utility weights. Reliability and worst-case loss are the user's stated priorities; ordering of remaining goals is a declared engineering choice, not contest points.
methodology.regret: Per metric: candidate loss minus best feasible candidate loss on the same scenario; missing objectives excluded, explicit zero included. No sums across units.
methodology.aggregation: Equal scenario macro weights; nearest-rank p90/p95; population SD; missing values omitted with n reported; no queue-length weighting. Public diagnostic excluded from selection.
methodology.auto: Offline probe only: select one of seven existing strategies on development rows of each family; freeze choices before validation; no holdout tuning. Deployment cost and unseen-family behavior not established.
methodology.commission: Estimated approved amount * provider_margin_pct /100; aggregate divided by total queued amount; real fee contract not supplied.
methodology.turnover: Mean relative min deficit or max excess over explicitly supplied bounds (denominator max(bound,1)); absent bounds null; explicit 0 remains a bound.
methodology.resources: Runner wall time and reachable decisions/report/manifest object bytes per run; process peak RSS measured separately, not attributed to individual candidates.
limitations: Synthetic scenarios are not a probability model of final traffic
Finite sample cannot prove mathematical optimality
Shared generator, IDs and seed blocks correlate scenarios; no IID sampling or significance guarantee
Count targets required by input schema; optional volume/turnover can be incomplete
Commission is an estimate; capacity is end-state pressure, not asynchronous production load
Resource timings are observational and excluded from deterministic fingerprint

candidate_rationale.distribution: Emphasize stated count/volume goals; reused bounded alternative, not public-queue fitting.
candidate_rationale.equal_goals: Equal active policy weights; test sensitivity to unequal weighting.
candidate_rationale.count_latency: Small combination of share, conversion and latency policies without correlated capacity preferences.

methodology.deployment_gate: Validation winner is adopted only if its holdout reliability ordering is no worse than the incumbent; holdout does not select a replacement or tune weights.

decision.reason: Balanced — единственный проверенный статический кандидат с worst-case regret успешности не выше 0,1 п.п. и на validation, и на holdout. Победитель validation amount_range не прошёл независимую проверку; прежние веса сохранены. Глобальная оптимальность не доказана.
decision.adoption_gate: Validation winner is adopted only if its holdout reliability ordering is no worse than the incumbent; holdout does not select a replacement or tune weights.
decision.joint_diagnostic_scope: Descriptive confirmation after the locked validation choice failed its holdout check; not selection of a new candidate using holdout.
